_comment: Good events: food, healing, sensory discovery, and safe navigation. ~45% of new pool. Health gains range +8 to +20.

events.title: Clear Mountain Stream
events.description: The trees open onto a fast-moving stream. The water is crystal clear and cold, running over smooth stones. You can see the bottom easily.

cues.description: Clear water rushing over visible stone bed
Steady rushing current
Clean, cold, faintly mineral scent

choices.text: Drink deeply from the stream

outcome.description: Cold and clean. Your thirst vanishes and your head clears. Fast-moving clear water with a visible bottom is reliably safe.

memory_reward.title: Fast Clear Stream
memory_reward.description: Fast-moving clear stream with visible stone bed. Safe to drink. Refreshing and restorative.
hidden_traits: still or green-tinged water may be contaminated

cue_tags.description: clear water, visible bottom
fast-moving current

choices.text: Check upstream before drinking

outcome.description: Nothing alarming upstream. You drink with confidence and feel refreshed, though the check cost you a little time.

events.title: Starchy Roots
events.description: Along the riverbank the soil is loose and dark. Thick green leaves mark a patch of plants whose roots you recognize — starchy, filling, and safe when cooked.

cues.description: Broad dark-green leaves on low plants along the bank
Loose, rich dark soil — easy to dig

choices.text: Dig up the roots and eat them raw

outcome.description: Filling but tough and slightly bitter raw. Your stomach settles eventually. Not ideal — they're better cooked.

memory_reward.title: Riverbank Roots
memory_reward.description: Thick starchy roots from broad-leafed plants on the riverbank. Edible raw but better cooked.

cue_tags.description: broad dark-green leaves on low riverbank plants

choices.text: Roast them over a small fire first

outcome.description: The roots soften and sweeten in the heat. A solid, filling meal — the best food you've found in days.

memory_reward.title: Roasted Riverbank Roots
memory_reward.description: Broad-leafed riverbank plant roots. Cooked = sweet and filling. Reliable calorie source.

cue_tags.description: broad dark-green leaves on low bank plants
loose dark soil, easy to dig

events.title: Abandoned Honeycomb
events.description: High in a split tree trunk you spot a dark mass — an old honeycomb, long since emptied of its colony. Sticky remnants of honey still coat the cells. No bees in sight.

cues.description: Dark waxy comb in a split tree trunk, no living bees
Faint sweetness of old honey

choices.text: Climb up and scrape out the remaining honey

outcome.description: Rich and sweet — not much, but pure energy. You lick your fingers clean. No stings, no risk. A small gift from the forest.

memory_reward.title: Abandoned Honeycomb
memory_reward.description: Old honeycomb in a hollow tree with no colony remaining. Safe to take honey from. Sweet and calorie-dense.
hidden_traits: active hives look similar but buzz loudly

cue_tags.description: dark waxy comb, no bees flying
faint old-honey sweetness

choices.text: Leave it — could still have bees inside

outcome.description: You back away. A few moments later the silence confirms what you suspected — the colony is long gone. You missed a free meal.

events.title: Dry Cave Alcove
events.description: A low shelf of rock forms a natural alcove in the hillside — dry, sheltered from the wind, and large enough to sit comfortably. The ground inside is smooth sand. No tracks, no smell of animal.

cues.description: Dry sand floor, no tracks, no debris
Neutral — no animal scent, no moisture
Still air, noticeably warmer than outside

choices.text: Rest here for a while

outcome.description: You settle into the alcove and let your muscles unknot. An hour of stillness and shelter does more good than you expected. You feel restored.

memory_reward.title: Dry Cave Alcove
memory_reward.description: Low rock alcove with dry sand floor and still air. No animal sign. Safe, warm shelter for rest.

cue_tags.description: no animal odor, dry neutral air
smooth sand floor, no tracks

choices.text: Keep moving — no time to rest

outcome.description: You press on, tired. The alcove fades behind you.

events.title: Patch of Healing Herbs
events.description: A cluster of low-growing plants fills a sunny gap in the meadow — small white flowers, serrated leaves, and a sharp medicinal scent. You've heard these described before.

cues.description: Small white flowers, serrated green leaves in full sun
Sharp, medicinal — slightly bitter when a leaf is crushed

choices.text: Gather the herbs and apply them to your wounds

outcome.description: The crushed leaves draw heat from your injuries and dull the ache. By the time you walk on, the worst of the irritation has eased. Old knowledge pays off.

memory_reward.title: Meadow Healing Herbs
memory_reward.description: Small-flowered meadow plant with serrated leaves and medicinal smell. Applied to wounds — reduces pain and inflammation.
hidden_traits: only effective when fresh — dried loses potency

cue_tags.description: small white flowers, serrated leaves
sharp medicinal bitterness when crushed

choices.text: Not sure enough — leave them alone

outcome.description: Caution wins. You walk on. Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Ripe Fruit Tree
events.description: A gnarled tree at the edge of the treeline is heavy with small, dark-red fruit. Several have fallen to the ground and split open — the flesh inside is bright and unrotted.

cues.description: Dark-red fruit hanging heavily, fallen ones split open with clean flesh
Sweet, slightly fermented scent from fallen fruit

choices.text: Pick and eat the fruit from the tree

outcome.description: Sweet, tart, and juicy. You eat until you're satisfied. The fallen ones were just ripe — the ones on the tree are perfect.

memory_reward.title: Dark-Red Tree Fruit
memory_reward.description: Small dark-red fruit from a gnarled tree at the forest edge. Clean flesh, sweet taste. Safe and filling.
hidden_traits: seeds may be mildly bitter — spit them out

cue_tags.description: dark-red colour, clean flesh in fallen fruit
sweet-fermented scent from fallen ones

choices.text: Eat only the fallen ones to test them first

outcome.description: A cautious approach. The fallen fruit is fine — nothing alarming in the first few bites. You gather more from the tree feeling confident.

events.title: Thermal Spring
events.description: A wide, shallow pool steams gently in the morning air. The water is warm — not scalding — and clear, with pale mineral deposits ringing the edge. Animals have clearly visited: there are deer tracks in the mud.

cues.description: Pale mineral deposits around pool rim, deer tracks in mud
Warm water, not scalding — comfortable to touch
Faint sulphur and mineral smell

choices.text: Rest in the warm water for a while

outcome.description: The heat works deep into your sore muscles. Mineral-rich water soothes your skin. You emerge feeling remarkably restored — looser, warmer, clearer.

memory_reward.title: Thermal Spring
memory_reward.description: Warm mineral spring with deer tracks nearby. Restorative. Animals visit it too — reliable safe water and rest spot.
hidden_traits: scalding vents may exist nearby — test with hand first

cue_tags.description: pale mineral ring, animal tracks
warm but not burning
faint sulphur and mineral

choices.text: Drink from it but don't linger

outcome.description: The mineral water is clean and refreshing. You fill your water supply and move on.

events.title: Buried Nut Cache
events.description: A squirrel scrabbles furiously nearby and darts away, revealing a shallow hole packed with acorns and hazelnuts. More than it could ever eat. The nuts look sound — no mould, no rot.

cues.description: Small hole in soil packed with acorns and hazelnuts
Squirrel fleeing — you disturbed its cache

choices.text: Take a handful and eat — the squirrel wouldn't cache rotted food

outcome.description: Hard and bitter raw, but full of energy. A squirrel's cache is a quality check — only sound nuts get buried. You feel steadier after eating.

memory_reward.title: Squirrel Nut Cache
memory_reward.description: Buried nuts uncovered by a squirrel. Acorns and hazelnuts — sound, no rot. Animals only cache quality food.
hidden_traits: acorns need leaching to remove full bitterness

cue_tags.description: nuts packed in a shallow soil hole

choices.text: Leave them — the squirrel needs them more

outcome.description: You back away. The squirrel returns almost immediately, chittering furiously.

events.title: Fish in a Shallow Pool
events.description: A bend in the river has created a calm backwater pool. Several fish hang motionless near the surface in the clear shallows. They are slow — the water is cool but still.

cues.description: Fish visible near surface in clear still shallows
Quiet backwater — no current noise, only gentle laps

choices.text: Wade in slowly and try to catch one by hand

outcome.description: You catch one after several splashing attempts. It takes longer than expected but the effort pays off — a solid meal of fresh protein.

memory_reward.title: Backwater Fish
memory_reward.description: Slow fish in calm backwater pool. Catchable by hand — need patience. Good protein source.

cue_tags.description: fish near surface in still shallow water

choices.text: Fashion a simple spear from a stick first

outcome.description: The sharpened stick does the job cleanly. You land two fish in under ten minutes. Roasted on a flat stone, they're excellent.

memory_reward.title: Speared Backwater Fish
memory_reward.description: Still backwater fish, speared with a sharpened stick. Efficient and high yield. Tool use = better outcome.

cue_tags.description: fish near surface in clear still water

events.title: Sunlit Meadow Rest
events.description: The trail opens into a broad meadow. Warm sunlight, no wind, soft grass. No animal movement visible. The silence is peaceful — just insects and distant birdsong.

cues.description: Open flat meadow, tall grass, full sunlight
Insects, distant birds — nothing alarming
Warm sun on your skin, no wind

choices.text: Lie down in the sun and rest

outcome.description: The warmth seeps in. Your breathing slows. A short rest in good conditions is more restorative than a long sleep in poor ones.

memory_reward.title: Sunlit Meadow
memory_reward.description: Open meadow with warm sun and no threats. Good resting spot — visible in all directions, no cover for predators.

cue_tags.description: open meadow, no animal movement

choices.text: Cross quickly — open ground feels exposed

outcome.description: You cross without incident. Nothing was waiting.

events.title: Birds Converging
events.description: A stream of small birds cuts across the sky ahead, all flying in the same direction just before dusk. You've heard that birds converge on water at sunset.

cues.description: Multiple birds flying in the same direction near sunset
Chattering bird calls in the direction they're heading

choices.text: Follow the birds

outcome.description: Ten minutes later you find a wide stream. The birds wheel and land at the bank. You drink your fill before dark.

memory_reward.title: Birds at Dusk → Water
memory_reward.description: Birds flying together near sunset led to a stream. Converging birds at dusk reliably signal water nearby.

cue_tags.description: multiple birds flying same direction near sunset

choices.text: Keep to the trail — you don't have time to detour

outcome.description: You carry on. By nightfall you're thirsty. You had a signal and ignored it.

events.title: Abandoned Camp
events.description: Half-hidden in the undergrowth, a campsite. The fire pit is old and cold — no one has been here in a long time. A pack leans against a log, contents still intact.

cues.description: Cold fire pit with old grey ash, weathered pack against a log
No fresh smell — just old wood, dry canvas, cold ash

choices.text: Search the pack carefully

outcome.description: Inside: a watertight pouch of dried meat, a small knife, and a folded piece of treated leather. Whoever left this left it behind for good — you take what you can use.

memory_reward.title: Abandoned Camp
memory_reward.description: Old campsite with gear left behind. Cold ash, no fresh sign. Safe to search. Abandoned camps can hold useful supplies.
hidden_traits: occupied camps have fresh ash and smell of smoke

cue_tags.description: grey cold ash, weathered equipment
no fresh smoke or food smell

choices.text: Leave it alone — could belong to someone

outcome.description: You respect the boundary. The camp's owner is long gone.

events.title: Marsh Cattails
events.description: A shallow marshy area beside the trail is choked with tall cattail plants. Their thick brown seed heads stand like torches. You remember hearing these described as one of nature's most complete wild foods.

cues.description: Tall plants with thick brown cylindrical seed heads in still water
Soft, spongy roots visible where the water is shallow

choices.text: Pull up the roots and eat them — every part of this plant is edible

outcome.description: Starchy and mild. The young roots are almost like a potato. You eat your fill standing in the shallows. Reliable, predictable, everywhere.

memory_reward.title: Cattails
memory_reward.description: Marsh plant with thick brown seed heads. Roots and shoots are edible and starchy. Highly reliable wild food — grows abundantly near water.
hidden_traits: pollen is also edible and calorie-dense in spring

cue_tags.description: thick brown cylindrical seed heads above water

choices.text: Harvest a handful for later

outcome.description: You pull a few roots and tuck them away. A modest but reliable gain.

events.title: Weeping Pine Resin
events.description: A tall pine tree has a long gash in its bark — old damage, maybe from a falling limb. Golden resin has beaded and hardened along the wound. You recall that pine resin has many uses.

cues.description: Golden-amber resin beads hardened along a bark wound
Sharp piney turpentine scent — stronger near the wound

choices.text: Collect the resin — seal wounds, start fires, waterproof leather

outcome.description: You scrape several wafers of hardened resin into your pack. It smells powerfully of pine. Useful in a dozen ways — a small find that earns its weight.

memory_reward.title: Pine Resin
memory_reward.description: Hardened resin from a wounded pine. Collected and carried. Used for: sealing wounds, fire-starting, waterproofing. Identified by golden colour and turpentine smell.

cue_tags.description: golden-amber hardened beads on pine bark
sharp turpentine-pine scent near the wound

choices.text: Observe it but move on

outcome.description: You note the pine for later. Nothing gained today.

events.title: Moss and Orientation
events.description: You've been walking in circles — the forest looks the same in every direction. You stop and examine a cluster of trees carefully. Thick, dark moss grows densely on one side of almost every trunk.

cues.description: Thick dark-green moss growing densely on the same side of multiple trees

choices.text: Use the moss to orient yourself — it grows on the shadier, north-facing side

outcome.description: The moss is consistently on one side. You use it to confirm your direction and adjust your route. The forest stops being a maze.

memory_reward.title: Moss Navigation
memory_reward.description: Moss grows thickest on the north-facing (shaded) side of trees. Consistent across multiple trunks — reliable directional cue in forest.
hidden_traits: less reliable in dense canopy where light comes from all sides

cue_tags.description: thick moss on same side of multiple trunks

choices.text: Climb a tree to get a view above the canopy

outcome.description: Slow going, but you get your bearings from above. You can see the river and adjust your direction.

events.title: Warm Rocky Ridge
events.description: The trail climbs to a broad flat ridge of bare sun-warmed rock. The view is clear in every direction. Wind is low. The stone is almost hot to the touch — it's been baking in the sun all day.

cues.description: Flat bare rock, unobstructed 360-degree view
Rock surface warm from hours of sun exposure

choices.text: Rest here and take stock of your situation

outcome.description: The warmth of the rock radiates up through you. The high vantage lets you spot a path you'd have missed. Rest plus awareness — a valuable stop.

memory_reward.title: Sun-Warmed Ridge
memory_reward.description: Flat bare rock ridge, warm and dry. Good resting spot with full visibility. High ground gives better navigation overview.
hidden_traits: exposed ridges become cold and dangerous in rain or wind

cue_tags.description: warm rock surface from sun exposure

choices.text: Keep moving — the view isn't worth the time

outcome.description: You press on. The ridge falls behind. Nothing lost, nothing gained.

events.title: Wild Onions
events.description: A sharp smell hits you from beside the trail — unmistakable. A patch of slender green shoots grows in a cluster, and when you crush one between your fingers, it smells powerfully of onion.

cues.description: Slender green shoots in a cluster at the trail edge
Strong, unmistakable onion smell when crushed

choices.text: Harvest and eat them — the smell is a definitive ID

outcome.description: Sharp and pungent raw, but every cell knows this smell means safe. You eat a good handful and feel the energy settle in.

memory_reward.title: Wild Onions
memory_reward.description: Slender green shoots with undeniable onion smell. Always safe if they smell like onion — lookalikes without the smell are toxic.
hidden_traits: death camas looks similar but has no onion smell — always smell-test first

cue_tags.description: strong onion smell when crushed

choices.text: Take just a few to test before eating more

outcome.description: No ill effects, as expected. You go back and harvest a proper amount.

events.title: Boiling Bones
events.description: You have remnants from a previous meal — bones with gristle still attached. A fire and some river water, and you could have broth. It seems laborious, but the nutrition is locked inside the marrow.

cues.description: Leftover bones with marrow still inside
Rich fatty smell when the bones are heated nearby

choices.text: Boil the bones for broth

outcome.description: Slow and smoky, but worth every minute. The broth is rich with rendered marrow fat and gelatine. You drink it warm and feel genuinely nourished.

memory_reward.title: Bone Broth
memory_reward.description: Boiling old bones in water extracts marrow fat and collagen. Takes time and fire, but produces concentrated, warming nutrition.

cue_tags.description: rich fatty smell from heated bones

choices.text: Not worth the fire — move on

outcome.description: You leave the bones and continue. A meal left behind.

events.title: Natural Windbreak
events.description: A dense stand of young spruce trees blocks the wind completely on the lee side. The ground there is thick with dry fallen needles — warm and insulating. A good place to stop before nightfall.

cues.description: Wind stops abruptly at the spruce stand's edge
Thick dry needle bed on the ground under the trees
Dry, resinous, warm air — sheltered from the outside

choices.text: Camp here for the night

outcome.description: The wind howls beyond the tree wall. Inside, you barely feel it. The dry needle bed is warmer than expected. You wake less exhausted than usual.

memory_reward.title: Spruce Windbreak
memory_reward.description: Dense young spruce stand blocks wind completely on the lee side. Dry needle bed insulates. A natural shelter that dramatically improves rest quality.

cue_tags.description: sudden drop in wind on lee side
warm dry resinous air, sheltered feel

choices.text: Rest briefly, then keep moving before dark

outcome.description: A short break in the shelter gives you more energy than expected.

events.title: Rain-Filled Hollow
events.description: A wide flat stone has a natural basin carved into it — filled clear to the brim with fresh rainwater. It must have fallen overnight. The surface is still, with no debris.

cues.description: Stone basin brim-full with clear still water
Clean, no mineral or organic smell — fresh rain

choices.text: Drink from the basin — fresh rainwater is safe

outcome.description: Completely clean. Fresh rainwater in a stone basin has nothing to contaminate it. You drink your fill and feel the benefit immediately.

memory_reward.title: Rainwater Basin
memory_reward.description: Clear rainwater pooled in a stone hollow. No contamination possible from a clean stone surface. Fresh rain in natural basins = reliably safe.
hidden_traits: avoid basins near animal trails — faecal contamination possible

cue_tags.description: clear still water in clean stone hollow
no smell — neutral clean water

choices.text: Fill your water supply but don't drink here

outcome.description: You collect the water carefully. No immediate benefit, but you're prepared for later.
